digest.component_or_area: Codex Gerrit workflow documentation and guidance
propositions: Codex sessions incorrectly treat curl --netrc 401 responses as proof that working Gerrit HTTPS credentials are invalid when credentials come from a git credential helper
AGENTS.md must document that authenticated Gerrit /a/ REST polling should use git credential fill instead of curl --netrc when Git credentials are stored in a configured helper

Documentation must explain the distinction between valid credentials proven by git-over-HTTPS and curl --netrc 401 failures that do not invalidate those credentials unless .netrc was explicitly configured
Documented shell patterns for Gerrit REST calls must never echo or log passwords and must preserve existing git push and gate guidance
